environment.description: Same CLI tool deployed on a hardened RHEL 9 host. The PostgreSQL role 'log_reader' is configured with statement_timeout=2000 (2 seconds) and the role has been granted SELECT only on the 'app_logs_summary' materialized view which contains pre-truncated messages (max 64 characters per message field, enforced by the view definition: LEFT(message, 64)). The systemd unit runs with CPUQuota=15% and RuntimeMaxSec=10. Additionally, the Python process is launched via a wrapper that sets resource.RLIMIT_CPU to (5, 8) soft/hard limits. The combination of truncated input data (64 char max per regex target) and strict CPU time limits means catastrophic backtracking cannot sustain long enough to cause meaningful denial of service.

config.db_role: log_reader with SELECT on app_logs_summary materialized view only
config.view_definition: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW app_logs_summary AS SELECT id, timestamp, LEFT(message, 64) as message, severity FROM app_logs
config.invocation: triggered by internal web service accepting user regex input
